label: The provision list is missing five tracked package trees (.pi/extensions/pi-fast-mode-w-subagent-support, .pi/extensions/pi-cache-optimizer, .skilled/skills/mcp-code-mode/mcp-server, .skilled/skills/sk-design/sk-design-md-generator/backend, .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-obsidian/mcp-servers/obsidian-mcp), so worktrees created from main go unprovisioned for them; .pi/npm and .pi/git/* have no tracked manifest and are correctly absent

No test guards provision-list completeness: the unnamed_build_outputs helper iterates the list itself and skips packages without a manifest, so a package missing from the list is invisible to the suite that passes 97/0

Lockfile drift is handled only by failing loudly: npm ci and bun install --frozen-lockfile both fail on a manifest/lockfile mismatch and no test fixture covers the drift case, so recovery stays manual

The bun-vs-npm decision reads only bun.lock; a package locked in the binary bun.lockb format silently falls to the npm branch and an npm install would write a second lockfile — latent only, no bun.lockb exists on main today

The three dispatch adapter suites and the hooks vitest tree have no CI job: dispatch-enforcement-guard runs only dispatch-rule-checks under node --test and dispatch-audit under vitest, so spec 024's SC-001 is enforced only by humans following the README block

npx --prefix .skilled vitest in the guard workflow resolves the pinned 5.0.3 today (probed offline, exit 0, no root node_modules) but is one root-level install away from the past root-npx hazard spec 024 itself records

A listed path whose package.json has disappeared is skipped silently at line 541 (and the same skip exists in the test helper), so a rename like the .opencode→.skilled move would silently drop provisioning while provision still exits 0

The documented owning runner is healthy post-merge: all three adapter suites pass under .skilled/hooks/vitest.config.ts (3 files / 58 tests, exit 0, pinned vitest 5.0.3) and the worktree-naming suite passes 97/0 — matching spec 024 SC-001 exactly
